tools.name: check_text
tools.description: Check pasted text or code (up to 16,000 characters) for statements of AI use and named AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, quoting the exact sentence. Does not judge authorship from writing style. Private: no public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page or file and read AI labels, AI-use statements, Content Credentials and saved creation records found there. Logins, paywalls and CAPTCHAs are not bypassed. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

tools.name: check_image
tools.description: Check an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or single-page TIFF, up to 20 MiB) by public URL or base64 for C2PA Content Credentials, AI labels, saved generation settings and metadata. Evidence comes from records in the file, not a visual-only verdict. No public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com

tools.name: extract_saved_prompt
tools.description: Read the prompt, negative prompt, model and settings saved inside an image by AUTOMATIC1111, ComfyUI (including Flux workflows), InvokeAI or NovelAI. Only reads records stored in the file; it never reconstructs or guesses a prompt. Screenshots and re-uploads usually remove these records. Docs: https

tools.name: read_content_credentials
tools.description: Read C2PA Content Credentials from an image, video, audio or PDF file (by public URL or base64, up to 20 MiB). Reports the manifest, recorded actions and digital source type, with cryptographic validation and signer trust as separate findings. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp
